description:
The device compliance state summary for this account.

TIP: Gets the tenant-wide device compliance state summary. Returns aggregate counts: inGracePeriodCount, compliantDeviceCount, nonCompliantDeviceCount, remediatedDeviceCount, errorDeviceCount, conflictDeviceCount, unknownDeviceCount, notApplicableDeviceCount.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure
